interpretation: Audit and audit oversight are scrutiny relationships, not ownership, ministerial control or delegation of public authority.
A blank cell means limited involvement by the Auditor General and an appointed auditor, not no audit.
Proposed plan years must not be silently converted into completed audits. The newer plan supersedes proposed future coverage only once approved.
The plans distinguish core government audit under section 10(2) from organizations with separate financial statements.
Trust-fund notes require separate treatment: the Supreme and Provincial Court suitors funds are expressly not audited.
